Combine domain inputs into the five CTAS input frames

Combine_CTAS_Input.Rd

Binds any number of Input_*() results together with a subjects frame and emits exactly the five objects ctas::process_a_study() consumes: data, subjects, parameters, custom_timeseries and custom_reference_groups.

Usage

Combine_CTAS_Input(..., dfSubjects)

Arguments

...

list One or more Input_*() results, each with data, parameters and optionally untransformed.

dfSubjects

data.frame Result of Input_Subjects().

Value

list with elements data, subjects, parameters, custom_timeseries, custom_reference_groups and untransformed.

Details

The per-parameter tuning columns CTAS expects (time_point_count_min, subject_count_min, ...) are added as NA, which instructs CTAS to fall back on the study-level defaults passed to process_a_study(). Setting them per parameter is a deliberate later decision, not something the mapping layer should guess.

The combined untransformed frame is retained but is not CTAS input; it is the detail object used for drill-down.

Examples

Combine_CTAS_Input(
  Input_Numeric(data.frame(
    USUBJID = "S1", VSTESTCD = "SYSBP", VSTEST = "Systolic Blood Pressure",
    VISIT = "WEEK 2", VISITNUM = 3, VSSTRESN = 120
  )),
  dfSubjects = Input_Subjects(data.frame(
    USUBJID = "S1", SITEID = "701", COUNTRY = "USA"
  ))
)
#> $data
#>   subject_id parameter_id timepoint_1_name timepoint_2_name timepoint_rank
#> 1         S1     VS_SYSBP           WEEK 2             <NA>              1
#>   result baseline
#> 1    120       NA
#> 
#> $subjects
#>   subject_id site country region
#> 1         S1  701     USA   <NA>
#> 
#> $parameters
#>   parameter_id                       parameter_name parameter_category_1
#> 1     VS_SYSBP Vital Signs: Systolic Blood Pressure          Vital Signs
#>   parameter_category_2 parameter_category_3 time_point_count_min
#> 1             VS_SYSBP              numeric                   NA
#>   subject_count_min max_share_missing generate_change_from_baseline
#> 1                NA                NA                            NA
#>   timeseries_features_to_calculate use_only_custom_timeseries
#> 1                             <NA>                         NA
#> 
#> $custom_timeseries
#> [1] timeseries_id   parameter_id    timepoint_combo
#> <0 rows> (or 0-length row.names)
#> 
#> $custom_reference_groups
#> [1] parameter_id feature      ref_group   
#> <0 rows> (or 0-length row.names)
#> 
#> $untransformed
#>   subject_id parameter_category_2 timepoint_1_name original_value lower upper
#> 1         S1             VS_SYSBP           WEEK 2            120    NA    NA
#>   original_category
#> 1              <NA>
#>
